name: arcanaforge
description: Sistema web multi-RPG para fichas de personagem e gerenciamento de combate

scripts.public: npm run build:client && npm run start:public
scripts.dev:client: cross-env BACKEND_PORT=3001 npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
